rules.pass: No version floor refuses the running version at the relay's height or later.
rules.warn: A later milestone will refuse the running version.
rules.fail: The version floor refuses the running version now.
rules.unknown: The floor or the relay's height could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.ok: The version {version} is accepted at height {height}.
advice.refused: The network no longer accepts the version {version} at height {height}. Install the current release. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.
advice.later: The version {version} stops being accepted at height {from}, in about {days} days and {hours} hours. Plan the update. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.
advice.later-height: The version {version} stops being accepted at height {from}, and the relay is at {height}. Plan the update. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.

rules.pass: The role runs the version that is installed.
rules.warn: The role runs a version other than the installed one.
rules.unknown: The role's version could not be read.
rules.skipped: The role is not running here.

advice.restart-pending: The {role} runs {running} and {installed} is installed. Restart the {role} to use it. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.

rules.pass: This build has no test-only code. A devnet build passes.

advice.release-build: This build has no test-only code.
advice.test-build: This build has test-only code and is not for a real node. Install a release build. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.

rules.pass: At most half of the peers run a newer release than this build.
rules.warn: More than half of the peers run a newer release.
rules.unknown: The peer list is empty or could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.current: {newer} of {total} peers run a newer release.
advice.mostly-newer: {newer} of {total} peers run a newer release. Update when you can. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/updating/.
